chunks: This will indeed be great happiness.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the greatest success in Islam?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse serves as the divine conclusion to the description of those who fight in Allah's cause, affirming that true victory is not merely worldly but spiritual and eternal. Shia exegesis emphasizes that this 'great success' is contingent upon steadfastness (istiqamah) and unity among the believers, reflecting the ultimate goal of the faithful's struggle. It underscores the transition from earthly effort to heavenly reward, a core theme in understanding the purpose of jihad and worship.
